title: Register a company
summary: This page explains that to register an unlimited private or public company, you must use a company registration form.
intro:
To register a private or public company that's unlimited (where the liability of shareholders is unlimited) you need to apply by using a company registration form.

A company is a type of business structure. When you set up a company, you create a legal entity that's separate from you.
